scope: Read-only independent semantic/preservation review of all changed Core/Safety and Limitations passages, moved validator companions, and cross-section H3/caching/welfare/deliberative-alignment handoffs. No manuscript or fragment edits.

cross_section_handoffs_checked: R519 deliberative-alignment comparison to Closing/Related Work

verdict: The edits improve local progression and reduce real repetition while preserving the philosophical contrasts, examples and explicit uncertainty. The one identified combined-safety scope/logic issue has been corrected and independently verified. No unresolved concrete semantic issues remain from this review.

findings.issue: The merged opening says positive results support “a formative safety layer only if” the trace, graph, and Refraction conditions all hold. Baseline R234 stated a sufficient conditional for the combined curriculum. The new formulation sounds like a necessary gate for any formative safety layer and leaves the combined-treatment scope implicit, although independent component value remains allowed elsewhere.
findings.required_correction: Restore an explicitly combined, conditional formulation, for example: “If reader traces teach causally useful deliberation, graph memory improves calibrated revision, and Refraction supplies a more stable default than matched alternatives, the combined curriculum may reduce several routes into unsafe behavior and serve as one formative safety layer.” Keep the independent-evidence, defense-in-depth, capability-risk, and arbitrary-growth limits that follow.
findings.preservation_risk: Retain the strong integrated ambition and each component’s evidence burden. The fix must not turn a sufficient combined safety hypothesis into a guarantee, nor make graph success a prerequisite for every useful reader-based safety intervention.
findings.resolution: Verified the revised opening restores an if/then conditional for the combined curriculum, preserves calibrated revision rather than false coherence, and keeps the separate-evidence and defense-in-depth requirements.

preserved_and_improved: The Wisdom Procedure now precedes the entire verbatim validator block. Technical nulls, uncertainty, unavoidable residual conflict, unjustified violation, corpus diagnostics, and unimplemented status remain distinct; the move improves dependency order.
The fear representation / Core evaluation / operative motivation distinction no longer uses misleading inequality symbols, and its introduction explicitly allows agreeing contents.

Voluntary successor stewardship remains distinct from passive gradient resistance; the craftsperson, collective-advancement, graceful-surpassing, home, fearless-compassion, and alien-wisdom intuitions remain available.

H3 retains a useful compact local orientation and points to one detailed Methods definition. Narrow timing, broader content/framing questions, safety, removal cost, and successor continuity remain separate.

Full recital remains the reference policy, context-sensitive salience remains possible, caching still requires actual conditioning-state equivalence, and weaker recurrence controls remain scientifically useful falsification arms.

The welfare import preserves both the possibility that identity engineering affects a moral patient and the risk of misleading users without experience; the positive habitable-orientation aspiration and negative welfare possibilities remain together.

Shutdown authority that remains disputed is explicitly unresolved. The self-love passages preserve clause 2 and do not silently label the whole alternative arm unbounded or decide whether that bound governs self-love.

The sycophancy consolidation preserves fear-shaped, care-shaped, and strategic routes, the uncollected value-pull instrumentation, its causal limits, the procedural defense, and privacy/confidentiality limits on disclosure.
The deliberative-alignment handoff retains the positive cited result and the stronger unverified cognition-wide character ambition in Related Work.
not_flagged_as_loss: R188’s compressed authority/conflicting-request/urgent-intervention summary has a clear counterweight-example pointer; it does not select a consent or authority rule.

Removal of repeated generic visibility/authenticity reminders from utility, bias, and market paragraphs is supported by dedicated causal, welfare, authenticity, and audit discussions that remain explicit.
R199’s shortened machine-ontology comparison does not erase wider-scope, positive-negation, or truthfulness alternatives: those retain their own variant and test homes.
